info.name: Audit Logs
info.description:
CredVault › Audit Logs: the four tabs (All Activity · My Activity · Team Activity · Security Alerts) with their counts, the time range (24h · 7 days · 30 days · All · Custom from → to), search and filters, the day headings, and Export Logs (CSV / Excel).

BEFORE YOU START
Fill baseUrl, email/password, adminEmail/adminPassword and managerEmail/managerPassword. Run 00 · Setup, then the folders in order (folder 03 reads the Event ID saved in folder 01).

Full details: docs/CREDVAULT_VAULTS_API_SHEET.md → Audit Logs.

item.name: 00 · Setup — sign in
item.description:
email / password — an employee with Credentials Vault → View.
adminEmail / adminPassword — a Vault Admin (client admin): sees the whole company's log.
managerEmail / managerPassword — that employee's reporting manager: sees the team below them.

item.name: 01 · Tabs — All Activity · My Activity · Team Activity · Security Alerts
item.description:
GET /audit-logs?tab=all|mine|team|alerts — the four tabs. `tabs` holds all four counts (the badges); they follow the time range and the search, not the tab.
Who sees what: a Vault Admin the whole company · a Branch Admin the branch's people · a manager their reporting line (HOD → TL → Employee → Intern) · everyone their own events and the events on credentials they own.
Response: summary (events, by_me, team_members, views_reveals, copies_exports, access_changes, security_alerts, most_active) · data[] (one event) · groups[] (the day headings: Today / Yesterday / "Tuesday, 03/11/2026" + its event count) · tabs · meta.

exec: try { const v = b.data[0].event_id; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set('eventId', String(v)); } catch (e) {}
try { const v = b.data.find(e => e.credential).credential.id; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set('eventCredId', String(v)); } catch (e) {}
pm.test('tabs: all · mine · team · alerts', () => pm.expect(b.tabs).to.include.keys('all', 'mine', 'team', 'alerts'));

pm.test('rows: EVT- id, time + seconds, actor, label, severity, chip, IP', () => b.data.forEach(e => { pm.expect(e.event_id).to.match(/^EVT-/); pm.expect(e.time).to.match(/^\d\d:\d\d$/); pm.expect(e.seconds).to.match(/^\d\ds$/); pm.expect(e.actor).to.include.keys('name', 'initials', 'role'); pm.expect(e).to.include.keys('label', 'severity_label', 'chip', 'ip', 'sentence', 'date'); }));

pm.test('day groups for the rows', () => { const days = new Set(b.data.map(e => e.date)); pm.expect(b.groups.length).to.eql(days.size); b.groups.forEach(g => pm.expect(g).to.include.keys('heading', 'events', 'events_label')); });
pm.test('nobody\'s but the team\'s', () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(e => pm.expect(e.actor.is_me).to.eql(false)));

item.name: Team Activity — as the manager (the people below)
02 · Time range — 24h · 7 days · 30 days · All · Custom (from → to)
item.description:
range=24h | 7d | 30d (default) | all | custom.
Custom: from=YYYY-MM-DD and/or to=YYYY-MM-DD — the viewer's calendar days (tz, default Asia/Kolkata). Either end may be left open (no From = from the start, no To = today).
Refused (422): From after To ("From must be on or before To."), a date in the future ("From cannot be in the future."), another date format, an unknown range.
The pre-request scripts set {{fromDate}} / {{toDate}} relative to today.

exec: pm.test('tabs: all · mine · team · alerts', () => pm.expect(b.tabs).to.include.keys('all', 'mine', 'team', 'alerts'));
pm.test('the range echoed', () => { const s = pm.response.json().summary.range; pm.expect(s.range).to.eql('custom'); pm.expect(s.from).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('fromDate')); });

item.name: 03 · Search, filters, timezone, pages
item.description:
q= searches the user, the credential (name or CRD- code), the action (its label: "Access approved"), the details, the module and the Event ID (EVT-123 or 123). The tab counts follow the search.
action= one action key (view, reveal, copy, share, request, approve, reject, export, …) · credential_id= one credential's history · tz= the viewer's timezone (times, days and custom dates) · page / per_page (≤ 100).

item.name: 04 · Export Logs — CSV / Excel, exactly the view on screen
item.description:
GET /audit-logs/export?format=csv|xlsx + the same filters as the list (tab, range, from, to, tz, q, action, credential_id). Up to 10,000 events, in the viewer's time.
Columns: Event ID · Date (dd/mm/yyyy) · Time · User · Role · Action · Credential ID · Credential · Risk · Details · Module · Severity · IP.
File: credvault-audit-log-<all-activity | my-activity | team-activity | security-alerts>-YYYYMMDD.csv / .xlsx. Header X-CredVault-Count = the events in it. The export itself is recorded ("Audit log exported · N events").
Postman: Send ▾ → Download response to save the file.

request.description: 422 "There are no events in this view to export." when there are no critical events in the range.
